2390-3966-6582.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-6582.description:
Gain life.
Aerith Gainsborough triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

654-2557-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-2557-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

275-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
275-5078-6709.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

3532-5078-6822-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2724-3963-6432.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3963-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Meneldor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

225-280-1170-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {1}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1965-5660-6872.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4460-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4068-7279.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-4907-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

1482-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1-5436-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-5436-5796-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

2043-4094-6252.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2043-4094-6252.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat from step 2.
2043-4094-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

213-2232-6017.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Life's Web has at least two divinity counters on it.
You have at least one other nonartifact creature card in hand.
213-2232-6017.description:
Activate Myojin of Life's Web by removing a divinity counter from it, putting Maulfist Revolutionary and another nonartifact creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Maulfist Revolutionary and the additional creature enter the battlefield, Maulfist Revolutionary triggers once and Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the Maulfist Revolutionary trigger, putting a divinity counter on Myojin of Life's Web.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Maulfist Revolutionary and the additional creature to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

880-2907-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2907-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many creature token(s).
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5663-5686--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5663-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

372-2239-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Ardent Elementalist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-2239-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5256-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

433-2725-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Tideforce Elemental and Llanowar Scout do not have summoning sickness.
433-2725-4543.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Tideforce Elemental by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand to the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tideforce Elemental triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1760-3563-4364.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Aurelia.
1760-3563-4364.description:
Cast Surge to Victory by paying {4}{R}{R}, exiling Flicker of Fate from your graveyard and giving creatures you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Declare Aurelia as an attacker.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aurelia.
Surge to Victory triggers, casting a copy of Flicker of Fate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Flicker of Fate, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

350-1722-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
350-1722-4050.description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}.
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Beck triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Beck trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

914-2136-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-2816.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, and you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

1221-1729-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Pathway Arrows attached to Shelob.
Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
1221-1729-4762.description:
Activate Shelob by paying {2} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Devoted Druid that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

1281-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Stitched Assistant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Stitched Assistant enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Stitched Assistant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

803-1821-3764-4659.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Arcane Adaptation, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2942-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2942-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, targeting yourself and causing you to gain 150 life due to Purity and Fiery Emancipation.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing 150 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3.

3554-4130-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Mastermind's Acquisition by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mastermind's Acquisition and Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

406-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout is paired with Brallin.
You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
You have more cards in library than the sum of each opponent's life total.
406-4703.description:
During your cleanup step, discard to your maximum hand size.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, getting a +1/+1 counter and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Brallin's ability from Tandem Lookout triggers, causing you to draw a card for each damages done to each opponent.
Pass priority, moving to an additional cleanup step.
Repeat.
